symptom: --spans after-spans.jsonl.gz fails: "line 1: invalid character '\x1f' looking for beginning of value"
cause: readSpanFile parsed the file's bytes as JSONL/OTLP without checking for gzip
insight: Decide on the gzip magic bytes (1f 8b), not the extension, then pick the format from the name without .gz — so a .pb.gz is still protobuf and a mis-named file still reads
